visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with dark hair, wearing a dark gray t-shirt with a colorful "PARAGRAPH" logo, speaks directly to the camera. He stands in an indoor setting with a framed Crayon Shin-chan poster on the wall behind him. (2) The scene cuts to a young woman with long dark hair wearing a gray and white striped sweater. A small picture-in-picture window appears in the lower-left, showing an older woman in a red cardigan demonstrating hand gestures. (3) The young woman mimics the older woman's actions, raising both hands into "cat claw" positions near her ears and drooping her mouth into a frown. (4) The young woman repeats the gestures with high energy, opening her mouth wide as if shouting. (5) The woman smiles and performs a finger-heart gesture while looking at the camera.

(2) The audio cuts to an older female voice from an inset video, delivering a calm and instructional message about breakups. (3) The young woman's voice joins in, following the tutorial; she makes sharp, high-pitched vocalizations sounding like 'Qie Ai' to match her exaggerated facial expressions. narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video is a humorous skit where a boyfriend warns his girlfriend not to copy a specific 'teacher' online. The irony is immediately shown as the girlfriend follows the teacher's 'anti-breakup' cute reaction tutorial, mocking the boyfriend's threat with over-the-top acting.
